panels.description: Dedicated volumes show kubelet used/capacity/inodes. PVCs on a shared node disk (local-path) show the node disk instead.

defaults.noValue: This database cluster has no PersistentVolumeClaims

properties.value: Shared node disk = kubelet reports the node's root filesystem as the volume (local-path/hostPath): per-volume usage is not available, the node disk is what fills up.
Bytes left: on the volume, or on the shared node disk for local-path PVCs.
Dedicated volume: used / capacity. Shared node disk: that node's root-disk usage.
